name: LOVEREC. -Mini Theaters-
source:
Taking place a year after the club members’ reunion with Hitomi. As they’re all moving up a grade, they’ve each begun to think about their futures. At that time, Nori announced that she wanted to attend the doujinshi selling event Natsucom. 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/01/05/january-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
故事发生在俱乐部成员与瞳重聚一年后。当他们都升职时，他们每个人都开始思考自己的未来。当时，Nori宣布她想参加同人志销售活动Natsucom。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/01/05/january-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
